label: Lifestyle slideshow

kinds.photo: A full-bleed brand photo with a big headline.
kinds.gallery: 2-4 photos dropped one by one onto a table as instant prints, each with an optional handwritten-size caption, e.g. moments from a project or an event.
kinds.cta: Closing call to action over a photo.

fields.photo.asset: The full-bleed photo for this scene.
fields.cta.asset: The photo behind the call to action.
fields.gallery.photos: JSON list of 2-4 photos from the project assets, each { "asset": "kickoff.jpg", "caption": "Kick-off day" }; caption optional, at most 24 characters. They land in this order, spread over the voice line.
fields.gallery.title: Optional headline above the prints, e.g. "A year of building".

description: Photo-led social video: full-bleed brand photos with a slow Ken Burns move, big headlines that rise into place, galleries of instant prints dropped onto a table, soft cross-fades between shots, then the call to action over a photo.
